name: Due Diligence Agent
description: A Deep Research Agent for company due diligence, covering DD planning, key due diligence workstreams, risk assessment, valuation impact, and report generation.
provider_note: Runs on OpenAI / OpenRouter / Gemini / Perplexity Deep Research (configured server-side).

fields.label: Target Company
fields.placeholder: Company name, ticker, website, or other identifying information
fields.description: Name of the company to be investigated. A ticker, website, jurisdiction, or other identifying information may also be provided when needed to distinguish the target company.

fields.label: Research Cut-off Date
fields.description: Latest date up to which information may be considered in the due diligence research.

fields.label: Additional Context
fields.placeholder: Add transaction context, specific concerns, focus areas, or other relevant information
fields.description: Optional background, transaction context, specific concerns, focus areas, or other information that may help the agent interpret the due diligence task.
